en: Black‑and‑white vintage image showing a steamship approaching or leaving a small wooden pier. A group of people in early 20th‑century clothing stand on the pier, apparently boarding or greeting the vessel. Low rocky islands with scattered wooden houses and trees are visible in the background, suggesting a coastal archipelago. The steamer bears the name "SKÄRGÅRDEN" on its side.
